text:
kiara: kicked off onboarding for courier-embed-v2 (float / int8-per-channel / int6-per-channel). Quick take: float improves R@1 on our multi-domain holdout (wiki+support+snippets) by +0.019 vs prod, int8 is within noise (+0.011). int6 shows a small regression on short FAQs. Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/courier/2026-03-21/run-402

ben: short FAQs meaning <=4 tokens?

kiara: yep. For the FAQ subset: Prod R@1=0.744, float=0.759, int6=0.731, int8=0.751. So int6 is the oddball.

oliver: curious about normalization. are you using post-dequant L2?

kiara: default pipeline applies no extra scaling. I ran a quick post-dequant L2 normalize and int6 R@1 recovered to 0.745 (almost parity). Script: `python eval/compare.py --model courier --quant int6 --norm post-l2`

maya: nice. Did you check Spearman ordering and top-10 overlap?

kiara: Spearman(float vs int6) overall=0.94, FAQ subset=0.82 pre-norm, after post-l2 FAQ rho=0.91. Top-10 Jaccard overlap on FAQ: pre-norm int6=0.62, post-l2=0.81.

ci-bot: full metrics uploaded -> s3://redwood-evals/courier/ci-402/metrics.json

ben: clustering sanity? small clusters shifting can indicate semantic drift even if recall looks ok.

kiara: ran UMAP(2k sample)+HDBSCAN: cluster count stable, silhouette float=0.18 -> int6 pre-norm=0.12 -> int6 post-l2=0.17. So post-norm fixes most of the cluster compression.

oliver: any pathological individual examples?

kiara: attached top 25 regressions: s3://redwood-evals/courier/reviews/top25.csv. Example: short query "reset api key" float sim->0.81 int6 pre-norm->0.40 int6 post-l2->0.79 (so recovered).

ben: sounds promising. propose canary gates: 1) global R@1 >= prod-0.003, 2) FAQ R@1 >= prod-0.005 after post-quant-norm, 3) Spearman(FAQ) >=0.9, 4) top-10 Jaccard(FAQ) >=0.8, 5) silhouette delta >= -0.03.

maya: +1. Also require human review of top20 regressions before enabling canary.

ops-bot: preview deployment created at /staging/courier-v2/quant-int6 (tag q-int6-stg). Canary toggle is off.

kiara: plan: finish full int6 sweep with post-l2, run int8 baseline for comparison, produce one-pager decision note and attach review csv by EOD. Will ping for manual review.

ben: thanks! I'll take the human-review pass. :thumbsup:
